signatures.description: Implement FROST (Flexible Round-Optimized Schnorr Threshold) signing for a t-of-n group over secp256k1: Feldman-share keygen, per-party hiding+binding nonce commitments, and two-round signature aggregation producing a signature indistinguishable from single-party Schnorr. Reject any party whose published nonce commitment is inconsistent with the binding factor it was aggregated under, and remain sound when t-1 parties collude to bias the joint nonce (detect the resulting known-discrete-log abort condition rather than emitting a bad signature).
